pr_body:
In preparation of #71773 all drivers API structs should have a `__subsystem` tag. 
Additionally all `__subsystem` API structs are required to have a `_driver_api` suffix.

Fixes #72009

issue_context.title: Required `_driver_api` suffix for `__subsystem` structs
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
Structs tagged with `__subsystem` are required to have a `_driver_api` suffix to allow all build scripts (especially in userspace) to work properly.

The following in-tree definitions violate this:
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c2c95e18ed01b642b46b118f610b29f10a2227e3/include/zephyr/mgmt/ec_host_cmd/backend.h#L106
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c2c95e18ed01b642b46b118f610b29f10a2227e3/include/zephyr/drivers/emul_sensor.h#L28
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c2c95e18ed01b642b46b118f610b29f10a2227e3/include/zephyr/drivers/usb_c/usbc_ppc.h#L53
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c2c95e18ed01b642b46b118f610b29f10a2227e3/include/zephyr/drivers/emul_bbram.h#L26

The script `gen_kobject_list.py` used for userspace, simply removes the last 11 characters (`_driver_api`)
https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/c2c95e18ed01b642b46b118f610b29f10a2227e3/scripts/build/gen_kobject_list.py#L140-L141

**Expected behavior**
Keep it consistent, and throw a build error on violation.

**Impact**
As these are already in-tree, and can be used out-of-tree, a deprecation process might need to take place.

**Additional context**
Some reference PRs #71090 #71773

would it work with the `scripts/build/gen_kobject_list.py`, regardless, simple enough but this ~~should probably go through Arch WG for stable API change~~ are any of these stable apis?
the structure declaration is indeed public (see below),  the scope however is very thin. perhaps it's fine as it is.
